> >Cann I play more than one event with Cicatriz ? I know you can't with
> >Giotto but what about Cicatriz ?
> >
> >Cicatriz
> >Clan: Nosferatu antitribu (group 2)
> >Capacity: 5
> >Disciplines: ani obf pot
> >Sabbat Bishop: If Cicatriz is ready during your discard phase, you get
> >an additional discard phase action.
> >
> >1.6.4. Event Cards
> >Event cards are played to represent events that affect the World of
> >Darkness as a whole. Once each discard phase, a Methuselah may use a
> >discard phase action to put an event card in play. Each event can only
> >be played once in a game. An event card is controlled by the
> >Methuselah who played it, by default
>
> IANLSJ, but the "Once each discard phase" part on the Events rule
> strikes me as meaning "only one event per turn please!" :-)

Correct. Once each discard phase, a Methuselah may use a discard
phase action to put an event card in play.
